lead.headline: The first win is in; Montgomery's injury opens your Week 6 flex
lead.deck: Kamara's back and Monangai's toe got no Monday news; Coker is 'on track' and Woody Marks has Houston's backfield while Montgomery is week-to-week.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players, and it is all on the bench or next week. Alvin Kamara had five touches for 2.6 while playing through a back injury, and Monday brought nothing new from the Saints. Kyle Monangai has no word since Saturday, when he was 'not an IR candidate' with Week 6 at Atlanta the target. Jordan Addison sat as a precaution and is expected back after the bye. Next week Minnesota and Miami are off: Justin Jefferson, Ollie Gordon and the Vikings' defence all leave your lineup at once. The result: Los Gigantes de Teca finished at 132.76 and you have 164.8 with Josh Allen still to play tonight. That is your first win. Since the morning, two things moved Week 6. Dave Canales called Jalen Coker 'on track' for Philadelphia, and DeMeco Ryans called David Montgomery week-to-week, which leaves Woody Marks as Houston's back in London. You hold the first claim; Tuesday's projections decide whether Marks takes Addison's seat.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to change tonight; three slots to refill and one claim to weigh
doFirst.deck: Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence are on bye in Week 6; Marks is the new flex option.
